responsibility: Declares the Rust AST classes for expressions and closely related attribute/meta-item literal forms. It defines the expression class hierarchy from `ExprWithBlock`/`ExprWithoutBlock` down to concrete nodes for literals, operators, aggregates, control flow, async/await, loops, matches, calls, closures, and inline assembly, along with cloning, attribute ownership, visitor hooks, source locations, and strip/error-state conventions; this file is the main expression-model header for the Rust frontend parser and later semantic passes.
